upstream.note: The live portal catalog is database-backed and newer than the repository seed data. Do not treat scripts/init-db-data.json as the live catalog.

scope: API and integration feasibility only. No BetterMakati runtime integration is implemented in this step.

apiSurface.purpose: List downloadable resources for one dataset

responseModel.importantConstraint: The API catalogs datasets and resource files. It does not provide row-level query endpoints over the contents of CSV, Parquet, ZIP, JSON or GeoJSON resources.

rateLimits.discrepancy: The dataset-list route description says 20 requests/minute while the current rate-limit config sets the search tier to 60 requests/minute. Treat the lower documented number as the conservative assumption until the live API is exercised.

liveCatalogEvidence.note: The public portal currently exposes datasets added after the repository's seven-item seed catalog.

examples.name: OpenHalalan: Philippine National and Local Election Dataset
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential neutral election-data input after field-level validation; COMELEC remains the authority for official election records.

examples.name: Philippine Barangay Boundaries (Hierarchical GeoJSON)
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential Civic Map boundary input, but the source snapshots are from 2023 and Makati boundaries/codes must be validated before use.

examples.name: Project NOAH Hazard Maps
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential hazard context; too large for direct client ingestion.

examples.name: Philippine Legal Documents Library
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential legal reference input; Juris or official legal sources may be a better user-facing route.

examples.name: DPWH Infrastructure Transparency Dataset
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential Projects & Budget / Civic Map evidence after filtering for Makati.

examples.name: Open PhilGEPS Data
examples.betterMakatiUse: Potential procurement evidence; specialized PhilGEPS tooling is likely preferable to loading the full resource.

technicalFindings.consequence: BetterMakati cannot ask the catalog API for only Makati rows from OpenHalalan, DPWH, PhilGEPS or GeoJSON. A resource must be downloaded and filtered/ingested elsewhere, or a specialized project/API used.

technicalFindings.finding: No application CORS middleware is present in the inspected worker source
technicalFindings.consequence: Do not assume direct browser fetches from bettermakati.org to data.bettergov.ph will work. Prefer server-side/build-time ingestion unless live CORS is separately verified.

technicalFindings.finding: The live database changes independently of repository seed data
technicalFindings.consequence: Resolve dataset IDs dynamically by search/name or store a validated external identifier with a refresh check. Do not hard-code seed positions.

technicalFindings.finding: Resources range from small metadata files to multi-gigabyte archives
technicalFindings.consequence: Never fetch arbitrary resources in the browser. Gate integrations by file size, MIME type, provenance, update date and source geography.

technicalFindings.finding: Dataset records preserve attribution, license, publisher, source URL and latest-version date
technicalFindings.consequence: Any ingested BetterMakati data should carry these provenance fields through to the local source record.

technicalFindings.finding: FTS search strips special characters and is metadata-oriented
technicalFindings.consequence: Use it for dataset discovery, not for searching inside dataset contents.

integrationDecision.reason: The catalog API is useful for discovery and provenance, but the actual datasets are downloadable resources, some very large, and cross-origin support is not established in the inspected source.

nextStep.scope: Implement exactly one Open Data use case.
nextStep.recommendedUseCase: OpenHalalan source integration for the Elections data/provenance workflow, using a controlled server/build-time extract of Makati rows rather than a live browser dependency.
guardrails: Verify OpenHalalan field definitions and Makati geography before importing anything.
Keep COMELEC as the authoritative election source where an official record is available.
Preserve source, license, coverage and incompleteness caveats.
Do not add rankings, candidate judgments or electoral predictions.
Cache the extracted Makati subset locally so Elections does not depend on portal uptime.
